thread:
mira: Proposal: composable routing grammar to enable tiers (gold/silver/bronze) + a compliance lane without pre-creating every slice permutation. Compose at request-time to keep control-plane size small. Thoughts?

alex: +1 on composition. main risk is policy-eval latency at request path. need microbenchmark.

sana: sales/customer input: finance customers require region+model pinning; health customers want audit logs + region pin. they will pay for strict isolation.

otto: ops: determinism is critical. suggest stable-hash(tenant) + affinity score to pick slice so re-routing is rare.

jamie: runtime: cache hit-rate will drop if we split too many logical lanes. propose an optional "hot-cache" add-on for gold tenants.

vik: proposed gates for prioritization:
- research: 2-week sim for cache/latency impact
- pilot: 2 paid gold + 5 silver tenants for 1 month
- launch: p95 latency within 10% of baseline for gold + 99.95% availability + cost within 15% of projection

alex: compact policy sketch:
```yaml
version: v1
rules:
  - when: tenant.meta.tier == "gold"
    then: {affinity: strict, resources: dedicated_pool, fallback: silver}
  - when: tenant.meta.compliance == "pci"
    then: {region_pin: eu-west-1, model_pin: redwood-llm-v2, force_isolation: true}
  - otherwise: {affinity: soft, resources: shared_pool}
```

sana: add migration protections: billing pause during move + warmup tokens to reduce cold p99 spikes.

otto: runbook excerpt: `mark_slice_readonly(S); drain_inflight(120s); redirect_new_requests(fallback); scale_out_if(p95 > threshold)` and alert CS + oncall.

jamie: pilot metrics: per-tenant p50/p95/p99, cache hit-rate per-slice, tokens/100k cost, migration cold-start rate. log shape: `tenant, tier, region, slice, hit, latency_ms, tokens`.

mira: action items: @vik run policy-eval proto, @jamie run cache sim (50/30/20), @sana prepare customer ask + pricing, @alex draft RFC for grammar. follow-up Wed 11am 30m.

oncall-bot: PagerDuty channel created: #pilot-gold-evictions

mira: thanks everyone :pray:
